Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
KNIVES, GINGIVECTOMY, DENTAL 



1- Scope— Covers dimensions and other requirements for gingivectomy knives used in dentistry. 

2. Materials-Knives shall be made of stainless steel conforming to Designation 40Cr13 of 
IS : 6603-I 972 ' Specification for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 to 3. 

3.1 A deviation of ±2*5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3.2 Handle- The requirements as prescribed in 3.3 of IS : 3887-1966 ' General requirements for 
cutting type dental instruments ' shall apply. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — The requirements as prescribed in 5 of IS : 3887-I 966 shall apply. 

5. Heat Treatment -The instrument shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to give a hardness 
of 650 to 700 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance-The knives shall be tested for performance as given in 7 of IS : 331 9-1 973' Speci- 
fication for blades, surgical, detachable ( Bard Parker type ) ( first revision ) '. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance — The gingivectomy knives shall show no sign of corrosion when tested in 
accordance with IS : 7531-1 975 ' Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of 
stainless steel surgical instruments \ 

7. Marking -The space on the handle shall be marked with the following: 

a) The number of the blade for fish pattern gingivectomy knife, 

b) Manufacturer's name, 

c) Initials or recognized trade-mark and the country of manufacture, and 

d) The letters ' SS \ 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The requirements as prescribed in 7.1 of IS : 3887-I 966 shall apply. The gingivectomy 
knives may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 20 October 1975 



@ January 1976, ISI
